variants.name: 750 g
variants.about_this_item:
• Complete, highly varied mixture for rabbits: fibres, herbs, vegetables and fruit
  • Contains all necessary nutrients, vitamins and minerals for an optimal condition
  • Fibres, herbs, vegetables and fruit support excellent digestion, good dental care, a shiny fur and perfect health
  • Tasty mixture with extruded morsels for optimal intake and digestion; no pressed pellets
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: derivatives of vegetable origin, cereals, vegetables (carrots 12%*, beetroot 6%*, peas 6%, parsnip 2%*), fruit (apple 2%*), vegetable protein extracts, seeds, minerals, oils and fats, yeasts, FOS, herbs (0.1%), MOS, algae, yucca. *dehydrated, % equivalent before drying.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 14%, crude fat 3.5%, crude fibre 13%, crude ash 6%, calcium 0.65%, phosphorus 0.5%.

Nutritional additives per kg: vitamin A 14000 IU, vitamin D3 1120 IU, vitamin E 73 IU, iron 90 mg, copper 9 mg, zinc 66 mg, manganese 70 mg, iodine 2 mg, selenium 0.2 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: An average daily portion of 50–80 g is recommended, depending on your rabbit's size and breed. For a complete feeding plan, combine with Nature Timothy Hay and make sure hay is always available. Refresh drinking water daily. For extra variety, combine with Nature Snacks. Tip for picky eaters: only refill the bowl when it is empty, so every meal stays balanced. Not for food-producing animals.
